verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a dedicated multi-jurisdictional EC/VC team explicitly supporting cross-border venture work (N26 billion-dollar funding round with international investors, Flock's growth to exit across borders), multi-jurisdictional cap table tools (UK/DE versions), and a global office network spanning Germany, UK, Italy, Spain, US, Singapore and China that supports multi-jurisdiction financings. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of redomiciliation/'flip' transactions specifically, and independent third-party corroboration beyond the firm's own site.
